evidence.title: CacheRouter: A Dual-Path Tool Routing Architecture with Cache-Preserving Main-Model Isolation for Long-Tail Tool Discovery

summary: A new AI framework, CacheRouter, uses a dual-path design with cache-preserving isolation to improve the discovery and integration of rare or specialized tools. The approach aims to enhance scalability and performance in complex, multi-tool AI systems.
title: Researchers Introduce CacheRouter: A Novel Dual-Path Architecture for Efficient Long-Tail Tool Discovery in AI
